title: Replacing the part on a line still prices it fresh
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use staging (preferred), or the Tiered Pricing QA site too once the release is deployed there; production is not needed.
  • Note the attached Today picture shows this screen before the release; the steps check that it still works the same way.
  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new category for this test, category B, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix B, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 50.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test at your location, part 2, in category B, cost $200.00.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer B, made after customer B's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1) and a special-order part on line 1, category A, cost $100.00, priced $135.00.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click the part's description to open Edit Part Request.
  3. Replace the part with part 2 by typing part 2's number in Part Number.
  4. Click Save Part.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • Edit Part Request opens.

Step 3:

  • Part 2 fills in with category B.

Step 4:

  • The line reads $300.00 ($200.00 × 1.50 = $300.00).
